title: Pattern and Specimen (2019)
headline: No defect was found in Theorem 2. A claim in the online appendix could not be settled because the final version of the appendix was not available; it is reported as unresolved, not as a defect.

claims.label: Theorem 2
claims.gist: A bidding ring is stable only if the discount factor exceeds the stated bound.
claims.statement: In the repeated procurement game, a bidding ring is sustainable in equilibrium if and only if the discount factor exceeds δ*(n, c).

result.summary: No counterexample among the games checked; the proof read line by line.
result.search_scope: Two to five bidders, cost grids up to eight points, discount factors on a fine grid; all stage deviations checked. The proof read line by line.
result.limits: Unobservable bids are outside the claim.

vor_check.detail: Statement, definitions and the decisive step checked on rendered pages of the published version.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.label: Claim B.4 (online appendix)
claims.gist: The bound δ*(n, c) is strictly increasing in n.
claims.statement: The threshold discount factor δ*(n, c) is strictly increasing in the number of bidders.

result.summary: A boundary cost level appears to give equal thresholds in the 2019 appendix; the final appendix was not available.
result.detail: In the 2019 working-paper appendix, at the boundary cost level the threshold is the same for three and four bidders. The journal's final appendix may restrict the cost range; it could not be obtained, so the question is not settled.
result.limits: Not counted as a defect. Will be revisited if the final appendix becomes available.

vor_check.detail: Only the 2019 working-paper appendix was available; the final appendix could not be obtained.
